parameters.name: ExpireTime
parameters.description: The time when the share link expires. Default value: 604800. Minimum value: 0. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: TargetId
parameters.description: The ID of the job to be shared.

parameters.name: TargetType
parameters.description: The type of the job that you want to share. Valid values: job and tensorboard.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dlc get-token --target-type job --target-id dlc0000000 --expire-time 60 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun pai-dlc GET /api/v1/tokens --region cn-hangzhou --TargetType job --ExpireTime 60 --TargetId dlc0000000 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
